comment: Upstream watermarks for the update-patterns skill. Each entry records the last upstream commit whose behaviour was reconciled with this catalog. Update last_checked_commit only after the affected concepts were re-read and corrected (or confirmed still correct).

sources.notes: Reconciled through 04296a7. The behavioral baseline remains the released Keiki 0.9.0.0 source previously reviewed in src/Keiki and keiki-codec-json; 9714d37..04296a7 adds only the OKF capability bundle and does not change watched runtime source, package versions, APIs, or catalog claims.

Reconciled 89ebe409..4a4f8a91 from the watched source, migrations, and package changelogs. The catalog now targets the released 0.12.0.0 six-package cohort (keiro, keiro-core, keiro-dsl, keiro-pgmq, keiro-migrations, keiro-ops) on keiki 0.9, kiroku-store 0.7, and shibuya-core 0.9. The range publishes Language 5 as the sole stable authoring contract and demotes Language 4 to compatibility-only, adds targeted stream-scoped reprojection (Keiro.ReadModel.Rebuild.Stream, keiro-ops rebuild reproject-stream), binds revision live handlers to one delivery capability (catalog-v7:/slice-v6:), bounds versioned promotion by an absolute database-clock deadline, hardens guarded external reads (KR004 all-row cap of 100, keyed set-result verification, crossed-epoch KR001, selected-overload grant reporting, migration 0030), makes fresh awakeables opaque with generation-0 probes behind Keiro.Workflow.Awakeable.Compatibility, and derives Keiro.version from Cabal package metadata. Added keiro/stream-scoped-repair; corrected the keiro, architecture, and messaging standards, including the truthful QueryFreshness/cursor-authority read-model API that had been introduced before the previous watermark.

Reconciled 6b6d637..b9aecf3 from kiroku-store source, migrations, and changelogs. kiroku-store 0.5 adds the explicit MissingCheckpointPolicy lifecycle and resetSubscriptionCheckpointsTx (already reflected), 0.6 adds visibleGlobalHeadPosition, and 0.7 adds Kiroku.Store.HistoryRetention with renewable leases, lockStreamHistoryForReplayTx/readStreamForwardTx, and the HistoryRetentionActive refusal. kiroku-store-migrations 0.3.1.0 publishes the frozen kiroku.subscription_checkpoints_v1 relation (0009) and 0.3.2.0 installs the retention tables plus KR001 DELETE/TRUNCATE guards (0010). Added kiroku/history-retention; corrected append-and-read, checkpoint-inventory, lifecycle-and-deletion, subscriptions, and the subject overview.

Reconciled 8c6ed5b..7158f3e from shibuya-core source and changelogs. Shibuya 0.9.0.0 adds the breaking DeadLetterReason ApplicationFailure constructor with startup-validated DeadLetterCode values, total code/detail projections, canonical rendering that keeps built-in strings byte-identical, and the shibuya.dead_letter.reason.code span attribute. Corrected messaging/shibuya-processing, gotchas, pgmq-jobs, kiroku-subscriptions, process-managers, overview, and config/kubernetes-deployment. The IR bundle commits are documentation only.

Reconciled b4cab75..9ee9a2f from all five package source trees, migrations, changelogs, Hackage, and the v0.5.0.0 tag. Added messaging/pgmq-queue-reconciliation for validated names, additive drift-aware reconciliation, notification crash recovery, Maybe-returning VT races, and the transient SQLSTATE whitelist; corrected PGMQ jobs and messaging gotchas. The watch paths intentionally cover each package rather than a nonexistent monorepo-level src directory.

Added because the catalog already carried adapter version claims (shutdown release behaviour, DLQ transactionality) with no watermark. Verified against the 0.14.0.0 manifest and changelog: 0.13.0.0 moved to the pgmq-hs 0.5 family and 0.14.0.0 adopted shibuya-core 0.9 application dead-letter reasons, adding dead_letter_reason_code and an always-present dead_letter_reason_detail beside the compatibility dead_letter_reason field. keiro-pgmq 0.12.0.0 requires shibuya-pgmq-adapter ^>=0.14.0.0.
